text:
{faith:nature}的种子和树苗会{b}生长{/b}：整件放在棋盘上的包里时，全局倒计时每走一步（走路和原地等待都算，打仗不算）就长一点，到一阶换个名字、效果变强。长过一阶就{b}扎根{/b}，拖不动了；长到最后一阶{b}连包扎根{/b}，它和它的包都动不了。

还没扎根时拿下棋盘（比如放到{zone:地上}），回来就得从头长；在棋盘上挪来挪去不算。自然之神不是当前信仰时它{b}休眠{/b}：不长也不退，扎下的根还在，加成不算。

texts.en:
{faith:nature}'s seeds and saplings {b}grow{/b}: while the whole item sits in a bag on the Board, it grows a little with every step of the global Countdown (walking and waiting in place both count; battles don't). Each new stage gives it a new name and a stronger effect. Once it has grown past a stage it {b}takes root{/b} and can no longer be dragged; at the final stage it {b}roots its bag{/b}, and neither it nor its bag can move.

If you take it off the Board before it has rooted (onto the {zone:地上}, for example), it starts growing from scratch when it comes back; moving it around on the Board doesn't count. While the God of Nature is not your current Faith, it goes {b}dormant{/b}: it neither grows nor shrinks, any roots it has put down stay, and its bonuses don't count.
